audit.whatIsWrong: The difficulty verdict (TRICKY, 7/10, 48.1% over 2106 games) is right, but the prose behind it was written for a male enemy and never named why the lane is hard.
audit.why: The lane is hard for exactly two reasons in the kit: Twilight Shroud (20/19/18/17/16s, cannot be selected inside) removes your targeting cue, and Perfect Execution (120/90/60s, two dashes, second one executes) beats a 410-range ultimate on an immobile caster.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 are Orianna's on range and on Akali's 110 energy Q; the lane levels out at 4-5 with Shroud; 6 and first item are Akali's; two items is Orianna's.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' and 'Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar'. Level 6 belongs to Akali here, and the one-third figure has no source.
audit.why: Perfect Execution at 6 is the single largest swing in this lane; Command: Shockwave is 110s at rank 1 with 410 range and no way to reach a target that dashes twice.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 yours on range; 6 hers on Perfect Execution; two items yours on one grouped Shockwave.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states you 'can't reliably land Shockwave through Shroud's invisibility' (spikes[2].text) and repeats it in content.late. That misreads the ability.
audit.why: Riot's text for Twilight Shroud is 'unable to be SELECTED by enemy spells and attacks'. Every damaging Orianna ability is location-based — Q fires toward a target location, W pulses around the ball, R launches enemies near the ball; only E selects, and it selects an ALLY. So Shroud never blocks your damage; it removes your vision of where to aim it.
audit.corrected: Shroud stops her being selected, not your zones — Q, W and R still land where she stood. The problem is vision, not targeting.

audit.whatIsWrong: Assassin's Mark was never mentioned. The page told the reader to react to ability casts, which is one beat too late.
audit.why: Spell damage rings the target; Akali LEAVING that ring empowers her next attack with bonus range and damage. The wind-up on that empowered auto is the tell, not the Q.
audit.corrected: Her combo tell is the ring on you — when she leaves it her next auto is empowered. Step back then.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shuriken Flip's smoke interaction was absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'The first enemy or SMOKE CLOUD hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target.' She can flip out and dash straight back into her own Twilight Shroud, which is why chasing her off a shove fails.
audit.corrected: Named in enemyWin and in the cooldown block (Shuriken Flip, 16s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: Every third-person pronoun on the page was male: 'He dives a ball', 'tax his roams', 'his farm path', 'his tower', 'when he hits 6', 'Make him flinch first', 'anti-heal early into his sustain'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists akali as female; the owner is 'you', so every he/his refers to Akali.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to she/her across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[0-3].why, breakdown.wave, dosFull, dontsFull and report[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven level rows rendered two different answers: full sides were Akali/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akali/Skill/Skill against content Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Skill/Akali/Orianna. Separately, phases[4].side already read 'Akali' while phases[4].why described Orianna's Shockwave doubling her lane presence — a row arguing with itself.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Skill/Akali/Orianna, matching the content layer on rows 0,1,2,3,6. Rows 4 and 5 are the exception: the row labelled 'Level 6' must be Akali's — every other line on the page (spikes[1], content.mid, breakdown.difficulty) already says she spikes at 6 — while content whys[4] and whys[5] were each describing the level BELOW their row.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Akali/Akali/Orianna; content win[4] moved Skill->Akali; whys[4] and whys[5] rewritten onto their actual rows (Level 6, then First item); phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten to agree with the Akali verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and dosFull[2].d called Twilight Shroud 'the fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s, not 15s — the reader steps up five seconds early at rank 1. Shuriken Flip is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and Command: Protect is 9s.
audit.corrected: Shroud 20/19/18/17/16s, Shuriken Flip 16s, Command: Protect 9s, all stated with the behaviour they buy.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted under 'Slow-field his exit path mid-dive', and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted under 'Greed the third Q-W when his engage is up'.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed — both titles promise a decision the body never addresses.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ended 'buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.'
audit.why: Zed is not in this matchup, and the kit gives Akali no heal flag at all — the anti-heal instruction spends 800 gold on nothing. Zhonya's against Perfect Execution is the real line.

audit.why: Perfect Execution's execute threshold is not in Riot's text, so 60 percent is invented; and a named item line that no longer exists is a placeholder, not advice.

notes: Level chart: rows 0,1,2,5,6 of the full layer disagreed with the content layer, and phases[4] disagreed with ITSELF (side 'Akali', why describing Orianna's Shockwave doubling her presence). The packet levelChart settles rows 0,1,2,3,6 in favour of the content layer. Rows 4 and 5 were the harder call: content whys[4] read 'At level 5 it stays even' and whys[5] read 'At 6 Perfect Execution...' — both one level below the row they sit on (row 4 IS Level 6, row 5 IS First item). Every other statement on the page (spikes[1].when 'Lvl 6', content.mid, breakdown.difficulty) says Akali spikes at 6, so both rows were set to Akali and both whys rewritten onto their correct level. phases[N].rating was deliberately NOT touched — see questionsForUser; sides and whys stand on their own. Biggest single find: Twilight Shroud stops SELECTION, and no Orianna damage ability selects a target (Q and W are location/ball-anchored, R is ball-anchored, E selects an ALLY), so the page's claim that you cannot land Shockwave through Shroud is wrong — the constraint is vision, not targeting. Missing interaction landed: Assassin's Mark ring-exit auto is the burst tell (dosFull[0].d).
